verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs advertise "completely in browser tutorial lessons" for hands-on learning, and the installation page points to playing with Angular in the browser without setting up a project. This covers both halves of the story: interactive tutorial and no local setup. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the tutorial's structure and interactivity (e.g., lesson content, in-browser editor/preview), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can try an in-browser interactive tutorial to learn the framework hands-on without any local setup

citations.quote: Try our completely in browser tutorial lessons designed to give you hands on experience with Angular.
If you just want to play around with Angular in your browser without setting up a project
